A little more clarity

What can I use for free?

Your supplier listing and core dashboard tools are free, including storefront editing, photos, packages, enquiries, availability and booking organisation. Couple Leads is an optional $50/month subscription.

When does WedSparks charge the 18% fee?

The supplier commission applies when a couple pays an invoice through WedSparks. There is no commission for simply creating a listing, receiving an enquiry or discussing a booking.

Do I have to buy Couple Leads to get enquiries?

No. Couples can discover your published listing and contact you without you subscribing to Couple Leads. The optional subscription lets you proactively discover couples who have opted in.

Can I keep my storefront private while I work on it?

Yes. Save a draft and preview it before making it visible to couples.

Can I import an existing profile?

The separate import page accepts your own supported files for review. Automatic imports from external profile links are later work.
